title: Concrete pipes on a crane truck
title_pt: Tubos de concreto em caminhão com guindaste
story: Concrete pipes lying across a crane truck; one chain shows, the rest of the lashing is out of sight.
story_pt: Tubos de concreto deitados de través num caminhão com guindaste; aparece uma corrente, o resto da amarração não se vê.

truck.uncertain: rear of truck cut off; three axles assumed from tandem rear and crane rigid truck

units.uncertain: concrete pipes lie across the truck, not lengthwise; length and exact layout unclear
large upper pipe, resting between two lower pipes

restraints.uncertain: possible chain near front pipe; no other lashings visible from this side

violations.note: top pipe appears to rise above headboard height

analysis.summary: A crane flatbed truck carries concrete pipes in two tiers lying across the bed, with lashings mostly not visible from this side.

links.uncertain: concrete pipes lie across the truck, not lengthwise; length and exact layout unclear
